address: 126 Bangsaenlang Road, Saen Suk, Mueang Chon Buri, Chon Buri, 20130, Thailand
bio: Attracting younger diners, this eatery has a reputation for fresh, affordable Thai seafood of uncompromising quality. The generous portions with sweet seasonings are good for sharing; the deep-fried mackerel with fish sauce is a must for its crispy skin and tender meat....
